name: cgq666/Chinese-text-sentiment-classification-dataset
what_it_holds: Small committed dataset combining a JD.com e-commerce sentiment corpus and a Ctrip (China's largest OTA) hotel-reviews dataset for Chinese sentiment classification; 4 stars, no visible dates confirmed (README not deeply inspected). Likely a static labeled-sentiment sample rather than a full crawl with timestamps.
why_useful: Ctrip is the dominant China travel platform; any Chinese hotel-review data helps proxy China/APAC lodging demand where public alt-data is thin (gap #7 APAC regional volume), but the dataset looks small and probably lacks per-review dates needed for a velocity series — flagged for someone to verify the fields before relying on it.
size_hint: small (exact row count unknown, not deeply inspected)

why_useful: Actively maintained (as of Aug 2026) low-footprint method for pulling current TripAdvisor reviews with dates -- could refresh a review-velocity series post-2020 where HotelRec stops.

name: DatafinitiHotelReviews
what_it_holds: Points to the Datafiniti Hotel Reviews Kaggle dataset (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/datafiniti/hotel-reviews) -- ~35k US hotel reviews with dates, used to build a RAG/fine-tuning knowledge base; repo itself is a pipeline, not the raw CSV.
why_useful: Points at a smaller, US-focused, dated hotel review dataset (Datafiniti) as an alternative/cross-check source to HotelRec and Kaggle's existing Booking.com 515k set we already hold; marginal incremental value.
duplicate_of_holding: similar in kind to the Booking.com 515k Kaggle set and Portugal hotel-booking dataset we already hold; smaller and US-only
